gloss: sightseeing tour; guided tour; tourist excursion

definitions.gloss: sightseeing tour; guided tour; tourist excursion

examples.japanese: {観光|かんこう}ツアーに{参加|さんか}する。
{京都|きょうと}の{観光|かんこう}ツアーを{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I booked a sightseeing tour of Kyoto.

examples.japanese: この{観光|かんこう}ツアーでは、{地元|じもと}のガイドが{歴史的|れきしてき}な{名所|めいしょ}を{案内|あんない}してくれます。
examples.english: On this sightseeing tour, a local guide will show you around the historical landmarks.

notes:
A hybrid compound combining the Japanese word {観光|かんこう} (sightseeing) with the English loanword ツアー (tour). This is the standard term for organized sightseeing excursions, whether day trips or multi-day packages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {観光|かんこう}ツアーに{申|もう}し{込|こ}む: to sign up for a tour
- バス{観光|かんこう}ツアー: bus sightseeing tour
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{観光|かんこう}ツアー: day-trip tour
- {観光|かんこう}ツアーの{予約|よやく}: tour reservation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ツアー: tour (general; can refer to concert tours, business tours, etc.)
- {観光旅行|かんこうりょこう}: sightseeing trip (broader; includes independent travel, not just organized tours)
- {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}: group travel (focuses on traveling as a group, not necessarily sightseeing)
- {周遊|しゅうゆう}ツアー: excursion tour (emphasizes visiting multiple destinations in a circuit)
